verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a developer-controlled custom vocabulary, keyword, or keyterm boosting parameter. The only related item says the model has better comprehension of domain-specific terminology, which is a built-in model trait rather than a way for developers to boost their own terms, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can boost domain terms, names, and jargon through custom vocabulary or keyword boosting so they transcribe correctly
